After absorbing a familiar the wings receive the respective enchantment
 (can still enchant normally before):

+ [#](5555FF)Blacksmith[#](): Unbreaking X

+ [#](5555FF)Dragon[#](): Mending

+ [#](5555FF)Guardian[#](): Protection, the level depends on how many limbs the familiar has
Angelic Wings

This wings is a [#](AA00AA)Celestial[#]() wonderful elytra and armor piece.\
 This item's true power is to absorb a [#](5555FF)Wingnis[#]() to imbue them with its powers, enabling [#](AA00AA)Creative Flight[#]().

[](item://occultism_extra_spirits:corrupted_essence) is obtained when the celestial spirit is killed under the effect of [#](AA00AA)Spiritual Chain[#]().
  To apply this effect you will need an [](item://occultism_extra_spirits:ethereal_rope),
  and some way to bypass the resistance that this item also provides.
**Drop:** [](item://occultism_extra_spirits:celestial_essence)
Celestial Spirits
Unbound Celestial

[](item://occultism_extra_spirits:celestial_essence) is necessary to achieve unimaginable powers, such as controlling greater spirits
  and obtaining marvelous items. To obtain the essence, a [#](AA00AA)Celestial[#]() needs to be summoned
  unbound into this plane, and killed. Be warned that this is no simple endeavour,
  and unbound spirit presents great danger to all nearby.

Yes, Lord!

 (can still enchant normally before):

+ [#](5555FF)Dragon[#](): Mending

Demonic Crown

Alternatively, you can gift a [#](AA00AA)Demonic Partner[#]() with the [](item://occultism_extra_spirits:demonic_crown), this increase their combat abilities, making them truly useful.
 \
 Also improve the potion time extension and now will increase the level of the effect.

This crown is a [#](AA00AA)Marid[#]() wonderful armor piece, initially it makes many
 monsters peaceful for you and makes the [](item://occultism_extra_spirits:venti_sandals) jumps infinite.\
 This item's true power is to absorb [#](AA00AA)familiars[#]() to imbue them with its powers. Check out the next pages.

After absorbing a familiar you receive the respective improvements when equip the crown:

+ [#](5555FF)Devil[#](): You will have fire resistance.

+ [#](5555FF)Cthulhu[#](): You will have water breathing, aquatic creatures also become peaceful and
 the crown will be enchanted with aqua affinity.

+ [#](5555FF)Bat[#](): You will have night vision.

+ [#](5555FF)Upgraded Headless Ratman[#](): Enderman also become peaceful.

+ [#](5555FF)Warden Upgraded Beholder[#]() (Needs all four previous upgrades): Warden become peaceful and
 you are immune to blindness and darkness effects.
Galactic path
**Drop:** Nothing, check [Essence Accessor](entry://extra_spirits/essence_accessor) to get [](item://occultism_extra_spirits:galactic_essence)
Galactical Spirits
Wait, this isn't a ritual??
The black hole

Finally, you have found a way to tame the [#](AA00AA)Galactical Spirits[#]().
 Present them with a [](item://occultism_extra_spirits:primordial_heart), and you will have their eternal gratitude.
 \
 Despite this, they are still very strong and will decide which job they will take.
 (you dont decide if it will be a crusher, smelter, or crystallizer)

Unlike any essence you have ever collected, the [](item://occultism_extra_spirits:primordial_essence) is forged
 by [#](AA00AA)Eldritch Spirits[#]() combining all others in a reverse process of entropy.
Unlock the access to spirit inner essence
Essence Accessor

This item is a very powerful device that can be used to access and extract the inner
 essence of spirits, causing damage. To use, simply right-click directly on the spirit.
Not a fenix

**Upgrade Behaviour**\
 Change the multi-jump, jump boost and slow falling to elytra flight and fall immunity.
Become airplane
**Provides:** [#](AA00AA)Better Drikwing buffs[#]() and [#](AA00AA)immunity to Levitation[#]()

Infused Belt

This belt is a [#](AA00AA)Djinni[#]() wonderful armor piece, that combine the [](item://occultism:satchel) and [](item://occultism:ender_satchel),
 at the cost of ender satchel binding a player.\
 \
 Right-click open the satchel and shift-right-click your ender chest.\
 Both keybinding still working.

After absorbing a familiar you receive the respective improvements when equip the belt:

+ [#](5555FF)Beaver[#](): You will have haste.

+ [#](5555FF)Shub Niggurath[#](): You will have resistance.

+ [#](5555FF)Upgraded fairy[#](): You will have regeneration.

+ [#](5555FF)Full size Chimera[#](): You will have strength.

All effects receive extra power when using other armors piece from this set.
Occultism: Extra Spirits
With extra spirits

Welcome to [#](AA00AA)Occultism: Extra Spirits[#]()! The "most official" occultism addon (since it was made by the biggest contributor).
 This addon is focused on, but not limited to, expanding the [#](AA00AA)Eldritch Spirits[#]().
 With items and mechanics that I felt didnt fit directly into the main mod,
 but which may eventually be moved there.
Deep Occultism
This version is just a public test, and new content updates will only be for Minecraft 26.1+.
Note
Remove durability
Bedrocking items

By creating, seeing, and finally holding this item, you feel for the first time in
 your occultism journey a brief connection with [#](AA00AA)Celestial[#]() forces, perhaps wonderful things can happen.

During eldritch mining, some [](item://occultism_extra_spirits:bedrock_scrap) are found. Through an ancient ritual,
 powerful spirits can inlay jewels to forge a [](item://occultism_extra_spirits:bedrock_gem_cluster).
 This is a legendary item for turning ordinary items into unbreakable ones.
Wind Powered

After absorbing a familiar the sandals receive the respective enchantment
 (can still enchant normally before):

+ [#](5555FF)Blacksmith[#](): Unbreaking X

+ [#](5555FF)Dragon[#](): Mending

+ [#](5555FF)Guardian[#](): Protection, the level depends on how many limbs the familiar has
Venti Sandals

This sandal is an [#](AA00AA)Afrit[#]() wonderful amor piece, initially it only negates fall damage, cancels farmland trample
 and allows you to double jump while flying with [](item://minecraft:elytra) if you have the effect.\
 This item's true power is to absorb [#](AA00AA)familiars[#]() to imbue them with its powers. Check out the next pages.

After absorbing an **upgraded** familiar you receive the respective improvements when equip the sandals:

+ [#](5555FF)Drikwing[#](): You will have a stack of large jumps. (Infinity when using [](item://occultism_extra_spirits:demonic_crown))

+ [#](5555FF)Deer[#](): You will have extra speed and step assist.

+ [#](5555FF)Mummy[#](): You gain 30%% to dodge attacks. (+10%% when using [](item://occultism_extra_spirits:demonic_crown))
I wish, I wish, with all my heart...
Wish Lamps

This lamp is a [#](AA00AA)Celestial[#]() prison, the greater spirit confined within will grant powerful wishes.
 To charge it, use the lamp to capture a nearly dead celestial, after which you can make a wish.
 Hold the lamp in your main hand and an item that represents your wish in your off-hand.
 See possibilities in next pages.

Used to tame a [#](AA00AA)Celestial Spirit[#](), with this book you can finally have extremely fast workers.\
Hold a [](item://occultism:trinity_gem) in your off-hand and use both on [#](AA00AA)Unbound Celestial[#]() when their health is below 30%%.\
Note, only the gem is consumed, however, the spirit becomes a [](item://occultism:fragile_soul_gem) if it dies.

Tie down a creature, paralyzing it for a few seconds with [#](AA00AA)Spiritual Chain[#]();
 doing so, however, will provide excellent protection for the target.

This blade is a special version of the [](item://occultism:butcher_knife), besides being stronger, when used by a demon lord
 (have a [](item://occultism_extra_spirits:demonic_crown) with all the improvements) it will defeat any enemy with just one blow,
 however it will cause damage to the bearer himself.

Receive gold nuggets when hitting enemies and a special item upon defeat,
 also enhances Dragon's Greed effect.
 \
 Can absorb the [#](5555FF)Greedy[#]() and [#](5555FF)Dragon[#]() familiars need **blacksmith upgraded**.

Use this item on spirits to absorb their forces. Once charged and equipped, it will defend you
 from damage. Reaching [#](FFAA00)1 million[#]() accumulated defense will give you a special effect for the [](item://occultism_extra_spirits:forbidden_butcher_knife).

Use it to set a destination for this compass, any point in any dimension.
 Combined with [](item://occultism:entity_wormhole), its the perfect way to travel quickly to wherever you want.

item.occultism_extra_spirits.forbidden_b: This butcher knife has inherent Beheading and obliterates any living existence when used by a demonic lord.

item.occultism_extra_spirits.ritual_dumm: The demonic crown makes some monsters friendly to you, it can also be used to empower a partner.
The infused belt combine the satchels and can be empowered using familiar's power.
The venti sandals improve your feet agility using familiar's power.
The Wingnis will provide their owner with limited flight abilities when nearby, can be upgraded to give elytra effect.
Eldritch spirits will forge an angelic wings is an most durable elytra, that can enable creative flight after absorbing a wingnis.
Eldritch Spirits will forge a bedrock gem cluster, which can make an item unbreakable.
Eldritch spirits will forge an essence accessor that can extract essence from spirits.
Eldritch spirits will forge a primordial essence, the mother essence, the most complex essence, the true essence.
Eldritch Spirits will infuse the activation item to make it unbreakable.
Eldritch spirits will forge an empty wish lamp that must be charged with celestial energy to perform wonders.
Celestials are a subtype of greater spirits, with this ritual you will challenge one.
Galactical is a subtype of greater spirits, with this ritual you will challenge one. You need an essence accessor to collect their essence.
